data.title: ddflow wait text output says resume with the token but never prints it

data.body:
Fixes bug B16e0083f21: `ddflow wait --timeout 6297` prints 'waiting at most 1800s at a time; resume with the token to wait longer' and exits 2 after 1800s, but the token appears only under --json (wake.token); in text mode the advised resume is impossible, and the follow-up line says only to run `ddflow wait` again. Found on PS-snapshot-calibrate.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B16e0083f21 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B16e0083f21 --regression-test <test>` first).

Not attached, they match nothing in the tree: ddflow/infra/store/snapshot.py, tests/test_snapshot_calibrate.py, ddflow/templates/upgrade/unreleased/knob_added.log.snapshot_max_mb.toml, ddflow/templates/upgrade/unreleased/knob_changed.log.snapshot.toml, ddflow/templates/upgrade/unreleased/knob_changed.log.max_cached_events.toml.
